headline: Brazil faces Japan in World Cup knockout round after previous friendly upset
summary: Brazil's Selecao, aiming for a record sixth World Cup title, will confront Japan's Samurai Blue in the round of 32, seeking to avenge a previous friendly loss.
details: Brazil's Selecao will face Japan's Samurai Blue in the World Cup round of 32 on Monday afternoon in Houston. This highly anticipated knockout match sees Brazil, a five-time champion, take on an underdog Japanese squad.

The upcoming clash brings a chance for Brazil to redeem themselves after a 3-2 friendly loss to Japan last October in Tokyo. In that match, Brazil squandered a two-goal halftime lead, with Japan securing a comeback victory.

Brazil dominated Group C with 3-0 wins over Haiti and Scotland after an opening draw against Morocco. Vinicius Junior and Matheus Cunha have been instrumental, scoring all of Brazil's goals so far, with Bruno Guimaraes providing three assists.

Star player Neymar made his tournament debut, subbing in for the last 15 minutes against Scotland, after recovering from a calf injury. His return adds significant firepower to the Brazilian attack, having a strong scoring history against Japan.

Japan, despite being clear underdogs, qualified for the knockouts for the third consecutive World Cup. They finished second in Group F, securing a win against Tunisia and two draws, showcasing their resilience.

Japanese coach Hajime Moriyasu expressed confidence, stating, "We do believe there's a chance for us to win." Key players like Takefusa Kubo, nicknamed "the Japanese Messi," and striker Ayase Ueda, who scored the go-ahead goal in their last friendly against Brazil, will be crucial.

Brazil's coach Carlo Ancelotti acknowledged areas for improvement, particularly in pace on the ball, but expressed satisfaction with the team's progress. He emphasized the need for "real grit" in the knockout competition.

The Selecao faithful are hopeful that Ancelotti can guide the team to its record sixth World Cup victory, their first since 2002. This match is a critical step towards achieving that long-awaited goal.

headline: Storm with thunder and rain expected in 11 districts by noon
summary: Authorities have issued a warning for potential severe weather across nearly a dozen districts in Bangladesh. Residents are advised to stay vigilant as the forecast includes thunderstorms and strong winds.
details: A weather alert has been issued for 11 districts across Bangladesh, forecasting storms accompanied by thunder and rain. The severe weather conditions are expected to develop by noon today.
Residents in the affected areas are advised to take necessary precautions. The forecast indicates potential disruptions due to strong winds and heavy rainfall.
